personal-dashboard-active-discussions-ti: Title for the Active discussions module of the PersonalDashboard.
personal-dashboard-active-discussions-la: Label that precedes the time when the latest comment in a thread was made.
personal-dashboard-active-discussions-fe: Shown in the Active discussions module in place of the list when there are no active discussions to show.
personal-dashboard-active-discussions-in:
Line under a discussion's heading on its card, for a sub-thread: the page it is on and the top-level discussion it belongs to.

Parameters:
* $1 - Title of the page the discussion is on
* $2 - Heading of the top-level discussion the sub-thread sits under
personal-dashboard-active-discussions-mo: Label for a button that navigates a user to the complete list of active discussions on mobile.
Aria label for a button that shows more active discussions in its mobile version
personal-dashboard-active-discussions-pr: Aria label for the progress bar
